'''Vash Taggen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Demolition Chief]] of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was killed by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-aligned individual around [[3643 BBY]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
